remarks:
Welcome to The Route 78 Pub & Residence — a landmark property in the heart of Strykersville offering a rare chance to live, work, and invest under one roof. Now priced at $550,000, this turn-key restaurant and four-bedroom apartment combine small-town character, proven business opportunity, and financial flexibility in one exceptional package.

Downstairs, the well-known Route 78 Pub has long been a community favorite — recognized for its welcoming atmosphere, quality food, and local following. The space is fully equipped and ready for new ownership, featuring seating for 100+ guests, an outdoor patio, and a beautifully crafted bar with hardwood floors and timeless charm. The commercial kitchen is built for performance, complete with a full cook line, walk-in cooler and freezer, prep and pizza stations, and a separate overflow kitchen. A walk-up ice cream service window provides an additional seasonal income stream and draws extra traffic in the warmer months.

Upstairs, a spacious, updated four-bedroom apartment adds valuable income potential or the ideal setup for an owner-operator. The apartment features open-concept living, modern finishes, a third-floor bonus area, and a private primary suite with deck and walk-in cedar closet.

Recent updates include newer furnaces and central A/C (within 4 years) and a full roof replacement (approx. 12 years ago). From an income-and-expense standpoint, the ability to live on-site while operating the business creates a significant advantage and keeps overhead low.

The Route 78 Pub & Residence is fully outfitted and poised for success — waiting for someone to bring their vision, energy, and ideas to the next chapter of this established local favorite. Also listed as commercial under MLS B1648806. Square footage is based on updated measurements at the time of listing.
